headline: Colonials Take Wind Hills While Stonecradle And Mercy Battles Rage
war_summary: Fresh reports reveal Colonial arms breaking into Mooring County, where the capture of The Wind Hills has touched off a sudden inferno of over seven hundred casualties and a sharp rush of reinforcements. Stonecradle remains the war's fiercest maelstrom, recording four more base shifts within two hours as over two thousand men fell contesting Buckler Sound and neighboring heights. In Linn of Mercy, the grinding seesaw around Lathair and Rotdust produced three further base exchanges, with clashes persisting right up to the hour of dispatch. Farther east on the Stlican Shelf, fighting erupted anew as positions around Thornhold changed hands under brisk fire. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage endures an unbroken attritional slaughter, absorbing more than seventeen hundred combined dead in two hours as casualty rates accelerate across both armies. Sustained fighting also grips Weathered Expanse, where over eleven hundred fell recently despite static ground. By contrast, the fury has abruptly drained from The Gutter and Fisherman's Row, where quiet has descended following earlier territorial recoveries.
